QuestionStmt.S: Identify the name of reaction for aryl halide with alkyl halide and sodium metal in dry ether to give substituted aromatic compounds.

Solution.S:
The correct answer is Option B: Wurtz-Fittig reaction.

When an aryl halide reacts with an alkyl halide in the presence of sodium metal and dry ether, a substituted aromatic compound is formed. This reaction is called the Wurtz-Fittig reaction.

General reaction:
$$\text{Aryl halide} + \text{Alkyl halide} + 2\text{Na} \xrightarrow{\text{dry ether}} \text{Alkyl arene} + 2\text{NaX}$$

Other options: Wurtz reaction involves two alkyl halides; Fittig reaction involves only aryl halides; Finkelstein reaction is a halogen exchange reaction.
